lines.en: Okay, look, Ross, I do not want Emma going to the playground.
All right, well, if you must know,
I had a traumatic swing incident when I was little.
Yes, I was four years old, and I was on the swing,
and then all of a sudden my hair got tangled in the chain.
And to get me out, my mom had to cut a big chunk of my hair.
And it was uneven for weeks.
And you made it through that?
I wonder who's going to play you in the movie.
Great, she's got like three hairs.
I know, I know, but they're just so beautiful.
Oh, my God, I just pulled one out.
I promise you she's safe, okay?
Now watch, watch how much she loves this.
Oh, look at that, she does like it.
Look at her, she's a little daredevil.
